verified_contracts: OS Terrain 50 is an Open Data bare-earth digital terrain model
grid and contour supplies are distinct representations and must not be interchanged as exact samples
grid data uses 10km by 10km National Grid tiles
ASCII and GML grid supply has regular 50m spacing
each tile contains 200 rows and 200 pixels per row
height values are calculated at pixel centres
the map-header origin represents the north-west tile corner while rows read west to east and progress south
grid heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1m
GML and per-tile metadata provide spatial reference vertical reference and flying-date context
exact TQ29 numeric promotion requires live archive bytes header validation tile metadata and candidate cell readback
